VID001_case_study_novara.text: At Navara Electronics, four SMT lines were producing something the naked eye couldn't catch fast. No office shelf software could predict them. The company needed a model built from its own inspection data. A digital grant funded the AI build, and a research segment brought in the expertise. Now defects are flagged before they ever leave the line.

VID002_case_study_tanjung.text: This is Tenjong Precision Works, a precision machining shop in to us that was losing tenders, not on quality, but on speed. Job scheduling ran on spreadsheets. Quoting, quoting took three days. Two machines sat idle every night shift. A pre-approved scheduling system, then a custom project to run machines unattended overnight. Quoting is now same day.
